text:
[LSCP.1.3] A schema declares its lifecycle with a single `scope`
keyword on the schema declaration that takes a value identifying the
lifecycle category, per the grammar at [LSCP.1.5].

idris.name: Lscp_1_3__lifecycle
idris.note: Three lifecycle categories: `Explicit`, and `logical` split by key width into `Relation` and `Entity`. `ttl`, event and ambient scopes are outside the engine (time is not modelled).

idris.name: lscp_1_3__entity_not_relation
idris.note: The entity and relation lifecycles are distinct.
